snippet.title: Funi Raccoon Game - Steam Next Fest: June 2025 Demo

Collect and steal everything not nailed down. Your new dumpster is nice, but it needs furniture. Travel between areas to steal and repossess everything you can find. Make a garbage bin a garbage home : )
